notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
easyPrerequisites: Elvish Guidance attached to a basic land you control.
description:
Activate the basic land with Elvish Guidance attached by tapping it, adding one mana.
Elvish Guidance triggers, adding at least two additional mana.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gilder Bairn, untapping the basic land.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.
